one_liner: Twenty is an open-source CRM with REST and GraphQL APIs, OAuth 2.0 with self-serve dynamic client registration, API keys, and an official MCP server. Builders can get credentials from a free self-hosted instance or a cloud trial.
auth_notes: Authorization code + PKCE and client credentials. Clients register programmatically via RFC 7591 dynamic client registration, with no manual setup. API keys are Bearer tokens created in Settings → Developers → API. Each workspace has its own schema, and cloud and self-hosted base URLs differ.
access_notes: Cloud has no free plan. Twenty's pricing page says "Start your free trial today without credit card." A third-party directory says the in-app 30-day trial needs a card. The Pro plan is $9/user/month, and it includes the REST & GraphQL API, webhooks and the MCP server. Self-hosted Free is $0 and includes all Pro CRM features, so a developer can also get API credentials at no cost.
blocker_notes: No real blocker. A free self-hosted instance or a cloud trial is enough to build and test. The API schema is per workspace and includes custom objects, so the toolkit should discover the schema at runtime.

evidence.quote: Twenty implements OAuth 2.0 with authorization code + PKCE for user-facing apps and client credentials for server-to-server access.
Twenty supports **dynamic client registration** per [RFC 7591](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7591). No manual setup needed — register programmatically:
Create an API key in **Settings → Developers → API → + Create key**. Copy it immediately — it’s shown once.
Start your free trial today without credit card.
Host Twenty on your own infrastructure at no cost:
Self-hosted Free: $0 with all Pro features (community support). No free cloud plan.
**Core API** — `/rest/` and `/graphql/` CRUD on records: People, Companies, Opportunities, your custom objects.
Twenty exposes an [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) server so that AI assistants — Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, and others — can read and write your CRM data
